item.title: ConformTxt 0.6.34
item.description: - New in Settings: Show in menu bar. Turn it off to hide the icon; ConformTxt keeps working, and opening it again from Finder or Spotlight brings up its panel. - A table copied from Excel always comes in as a normal paste, in every app, with its colors and borders (in Mimestream it could lose its cell colors). - The panel has the same look as System Settings and ConvertExt: white behind light gray boxes.
